newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH FIXTURES FOR JAN 10-13.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH FIXTURES FOR JAN 10-13.

text.p: English and Scottish league soccer
fixtures for period Janunary 10-13:
Friday, Jan 10: English division one - Stoke v Birmingham,
Tranmere v Swindon.
Saturday, Jan 11: English Premier league - Aston Villa v
Newcastle, Blackburn v Coventry, Leeds v Leicester, Liverpool v
West Ham, Middlesbrough v Southampton, Nottingham Forest v
Chelsea, Sheffield Wednesday v Everton, Sunderland v Arsenal,
Wimbledon v Derby.
Division one - Bradford v Oxford, Grimsby v Port Vale,
Ipswich v Sheffield United, Manchester City v Crystal Palace,
Oldham v Huddersfield, Portsmouth v Bolton, Queen's Park Rangers
v Barnsley, Reading v Charlton, Southend v Norwich.
Division two - Blackpool v Luton, Bournemouth v Rotherham,
Bristol City v Burnley, Bury v Walsall, Chesterfield v Bristol
Rovers, Gillingham v Stockport, Millwall v Preston, Plymouth v
Crewe, Watford v Shrewsbury, Wrexham v Notts County, Wycombe v
Peterborough, York v Brentford.
Division three - Barnet v Scunthorpe, Brighton v
Northampton, Cambridge United v Exeter, Cardiff v Lincoln,
Carlisle v Torquay, Chester v Hartlepool, Doncaster v
Colchester, Fulham v Darlington, Hereford v Mansfield, Hull v
Swansea, Leyton Orient v Rochdale, Wigan v Scarborough.
Scottish Cup second - East Stirling v Brora Rangers, Ross
County v Montrose, Stranraer v Inverness C.Thistle, Spartans v
Arbroath, Whitehill v Queen of the South.
Scottish Premier - Dunfermline v Dundee United, Hearts v
Celtic, Kilmarnock v Raith, Motherwell v Hibernian.
Scottish division one - Clydebank v St Mirren, Dundee v
Airdrieonians, Greenock Morton v East Fife, Stirling v Falkirk.
Scottish division two - Berwick v Dumbarton, Brechin v
Hamilton, Stenhousemuir v Livingston.
Scottish division three - Albion v Alloa.
Sunday, Jan 12: English Premier league - Tottenham v
Manchester United. Division one - Wolverhampton v West Bromwich.
Scottish Premier division - Rangers v Aberdeen.
Monday, Jan 13: English F.A. Cup third round - Hednesford v
York.
Scottish Cup second round - Cowdenbeath v Dumbarton, Forfar
v Alloa.
Scottish Division one - St Johnstone v Partick.
